name: The Big Beyond
source:
You play as a young elf who upon reaching adulthood decides to follow in the footsteps of his father who's a legendary adventurer.

You start by making a name for yourself in the kingdom by completing various quests and exploring the big beyond in the process. 

[From [URL=https://tjop.itch.io/the-big-beyond]itch.io[/URL].]
